title: Open the keyword-action window on explore and give investigate an event
clause: "If a creature you control would explore, instead it explores, then it explores again" (Topography Tracker); "each Merfolk creature you control explores" (Hakbal); "Whenever you investigate for the first time each turn, investigate an additional time" (Erdwal Illuminator)
why: game/explore.go says in its header: 'Not built: CR 701.44d's APNAP ordering of simultaneous explores (no catalogued card explores more than one permanent at a time), and a CR 614 window on the action (Topography Tracker)'. game/keyword_action.go has KeywordAction constants for proliferate/scry/surveil/earthbend/amass/learn/connive only and names 'investigate, explore' as the next arms. Investigate has no engine presence at all (card-side Clue creation, e.g. cmdrB1Investigate), so 'whenever you investigate' has nothing to trigger on: add KeywordActionExplore / KeywordActionInvestigate arms + an EventInvestigated, route the ~69 investigating cards' helper through it, and a keyed multi-permanent explore.
checked: read game/explore.go header (lines 44-47) and game/keyword_action.go (constants at lines 83-128); grep 'EventInvestigat' in game/: 0; grep -i 'investigat' in game/: only the keyword_action.go comment; grep 'Whenever you investigate' in effects: 0; grep 'explores again|explore.*instead' hits only unrelated cards (twists_and_turns.go, over_the_edge.go, defossilize.go). Single explore (Francisco, batch 6) already works and is not in this seam.
